reason: I'd probably add it to the group and burn the 40 free documents, but $19 a month for something my admin already does by hand is hard to justify. The missing receipts at month end are a staff problem, and a bot can't read a receipt nobody sent.
objection: It only catches what people actually post in the chat. My real headache is the receipts that never get sent, so I'd be paying monthly and still chasing staff.
would_change_my_mind: If the free trial showed it saving my admin several hours at month end, or it chased staff for missing receipts automatically, I'd pay $19, but only if I could cancel any time.
